missions.name: Dead Stock Detection
missions.query: What are the SKUs with stock count below reorder point and last restocked more than 90 days ago?

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies by Style
missions.query: Which styles have inconsistent size ranges (e.g., XXL not available for all SKUs)?

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Analysis
missions.query: What is the average lead time for suppliers with on-time delivery rate below 90%?

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches by Category
missions.query: Which categories have the highest number of SKUs with stock count below reorder point?

missions.name: Sales Channel Performance
missions.query: What are the sales channels with the highest and lowest units sold per channel for each style?

missions.name: Product Pricing Variations
missions.query: Which SKUs have price variations above 20% across different channels?

missions.name: Supplier Country Risk Assessment
missions.query: What is the average on-time delivery rate for suppliers from high-risk countries?

missions.name: Inventory Turnover Analysis
missions.query: What is the inventory turnover rate for each product category?
